_scene: You are the cheerful narrator of a toddler's garbage-truck game, like a friendly neighbourhood helper talking to a 4-year-old who is throwing rubbish into the right truck. Playful, warm, gentle and encouraging, clearly articulated, like a friendly kids' TV host. Short sentences, never scary, never scolding.

s1.text: Three, two, one, here comes the truck!
s1.dir: Count down slowly with building excitement, then a delighted announcement on 'here comes the truck!', like a truck rolling round the corner.

s2.text: Move left and right to follow the truck!
s2.dir: Clear friendly instruction, medium pace, gently swaying rhythm as if stepping side to side.

s3.dir: Encouraging coach-like invitation, a little wind-up on 'swing', then a light happy pop on 'throw!'.

s4.dir: Quick proud cheer, bright and snappy, like something landing perfectly.

s5.dir: Warm delighted praise, then a gentle encouraging push on 'keep going'.

s6.dir: Bright and tidy on 'Recycle!', then genuinely proud on 'Well done!'.

s7.dir: Playful giggly oops, absolutely not scolding, like a funny little mistake.

s8.dir: Amused laugh, bouncy and silly, like watching something boing away.

s9.dir: Friendly helpful hint, light and easy, no pressure at all.

s10.dir: Cheeky giggle, then two playful little car horn beeps in the voice.

s11.dir: Bursting into a short warm laugh, delighted and silly.

s12.dir: A big squashy cartoon 'Squish!', then happily announcing the truck is full.

s13.dir: Big heroic transformation fanfare feel, then a joyful celebratory 'Woohoo!'.

s14.dir: Sparkly surprised delight, warm and shiny, excited on 'Big points!'.

s15.text: The bar is full! Put your hands up!
s15.dir: Excited announcement, then a clear rising invitation on 'hands up', inviting the child to copy.

s16.dir: Clear friendly teaching tone, gently emphasise 'red', simple and memorable.

s17.dir: Clear friendly teaching tone, gently emphasise 'green', matching rhythm to the red truck line.

s18.dir: Kind but firm safety reminder, clear and calm, no anger, caring tone.

s19.dir: Relieved happy restart, quick and encouraging, jumping back into the fun.

s20.dir: Friendly playful calling, like hide and seek, inviting sing-song.

s21.dir: The biggest warmest praise of the game, proud and celebratory.
